title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Lemon, Pear and Raspberry E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: This incredibly well-balanced eliquid from Rachael Rabbit is a delightful fusion of sharp and zesty lemon, with sharp, tangy raspberry and the mellow sweetness of fresh pear. A truly essential vape for fruit lovers. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
